courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: Make more of your courtyard or alfresco with tiles suited to outdoor living. We prepare the base, plan drainage and set out the tiles around doors, paths and steps for a connected outdoor finish.
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 用适合户外生活的瓷砖，升级庭院与有顶棚休闲区。我们处理基层、规划排水，围绕门口、步道与台阶排砖，让户外地面衔接自然。

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 庭院与户外休闲区贴砖：排水与伸缩缝

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: We tile courtyard and alfresco floor areas, planning the finish around outdoor use, adjoining paths and doorways. The assessment looks at the existing base, levels and where surface water can drain before tile layout and preparation are confirmed.
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 我们铺设庭院及 alfresco 户外休闲区地砖，结合户外使用、相邻步道和门口规划饰面。确认排砖与准备前，先评估现有基层、高度及表面排水去向。

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: Outdoor tile selection is more than choosing a colour. We check the proposed material for the location and use, alongside the available product information, cleaning needs and edge details. A textured appearance alone does not establish slip performance.
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 选室外砖不只看颜色，需结合位置用途、产品资料、清洁及边缘做法核对材料。纹理外观本身不能证明防滑性能。

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: Movement joints and connections to the building need a deliberate detail rather than being covered with ordinary grout. Any required waterproofing is assessed for the particular construction; not every outdoor area uses the same system.
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 伸缩缝及建筑连接需专门细部，不能用普通填缝覆盖。必要防水按具体构造评估，并非所有户外区域都用相同系统。

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 住宅与庭院旁有顶棚户外区域铺设的灰色地砖

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 基层准备、伸缩缝及施工期间通行。

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: Include steps or changes in level in your enquiry so their suitability and details can be assessed separately.
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 咨询时请说明台阶或高差，便于单独评估适用性和细部。

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: Surface water can arrive from adjoining paving as well as fall directly on the tiles. We assess that runoff and the relationship between courtyard levels, indoor floors and drainage points. A tile overlay changes finished heights and may affect clearance at doors. Preparation and any level changes are agreed before the layout, with access to drains kept part of the finish.
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 地表水可能来自相邻铺装径流，也可能直接落在砖面。我们评估水流，以及庭院高度、室内地面和排水点的关系。覆盖铺砖改变完成面高度，可能影响门口净空；排布前确认准备和高度变化，饰面也需保留排水口通道。

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: Exterior tile suitability and movement joints
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 室外砖适用性与伸缩缝

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: Tile suitability depends on the product information and the intended outdoor use, including wet conditions and cleaning. We discuss edges, cuts and movement junctions with the selected format. Existing cracks need assessment before they are concealed; ordinary grout is not a substitute for a movement detail. Steps or other changes in level are identified separately in the written scope.
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 适用性取决于产品资料及户外用途，包括潮湿和清洁条件。按选定规格讨论边缘、切割及伸缩交接。旧裂缝覆盖前需评估，普通填缝不能替代位移细部。台阶及其他高差在书面范围单独列明。
庭院与户外休闲区排布

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: Describe the outdoor area, current surface and connections to doors, paths or steps. We assess the base and drainage before planning the layout.
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 描述室外区域、现有表面及与门、步道或台阶的连接。排布前评估基层与排水。

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: Material suitability, movement joints and access during curing are agreed for the exterior finish.
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 室外饰面需确认材料适用性、伸缩缝及养护期间通行。

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: Outdoor porcelain for courtyards, alfresco areas and steps
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 庭院、alfresco 休闲区与台阶户外瓷质砖

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: We install outdoor porcelain tiles across courtyards and covered alfresco areas, connecting doors, paths and steps through a planned set-out. Stone-look and textured porcelain create different visual finishes. We consider the selected slip-resistance information, cleaning needs and exposure when discussing the surface, rather than choosing by colour alone.
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 我们为庭院与有顶棚 alfresco 休闲区铺设户外瓷质砖，通过排版衔接门口、步道与台阶。仿石及纹理瓷质砖可形成不同饰面；沟通选材时兼顾产品防滑信息、清洁需求和日晒雨淋环境，而不只比较颜色。

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: Large outdoor tiles still need suitable falls, a prepared base and movement joints. We plan the cuts at posts and drainage points, step edges and adjoining floor heights before installation. Share the tile format and the outdoor areas involved to discuss a courtyard or alfresco tiling quote.
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 户外大规格砖同样需要合适坡向、处理好的基层及活动缝。施工前安排立柱和排水点切砖、台阶边缘与相邻地面高度。提供砖规格及户外施工区域，即可沟通庭院或 alfresco 地面报价。

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 庭院积水与砖面排水坡度

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: A clear surface grate does not prove the drainage pipe is clear or has enough capacity. Puddles can also relate to low spots in the tile bed, adjoining ground levels or the way water reaches the outlet. Note where water collects, whether the outlet backs up and how long the puddle remains after rain stops.
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 表面排水格栅没有杂物，不代表下方管道畅通或排水能力足够。积水也可能与铺砖层低洼、相邻地面高度或水流通往排水口的路径有关。请记录积水位置、排水口是否返水，以及停雨后积水持续多久。

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: For courtyard or alfresco retiling, we check the accessible base, proposed falls, step edges and door levels before selecting outdoor porcelain tiles and planning the installation. A blocked or damaged stormwater pipe needs separate drainage assessment before surface work is agreed. New grout or a slip-resistant tile finish will not correct an unsuitable drainage fall.
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 庭院或休闲区重新铺砖前，我们检查可见基层、拟定排水坡度、台阶边缘与门口高度，再选择户外瓷质砖并规划铺贴。如雨水管堵塞或损坏，应先另行进行排水评估，再商定表面工程。新填缝或防滑砖面不能纠正不合适的排水坡度。

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: Outdoor porcelain, pavers and exposed surface care
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 户外瓷质砖、铺装板与外露表面养护

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: We assess the actual exterior material and specification. Stone-look describes appearance; terracotta may identify fired clay or only a product colour; bluestone is a stone trade name that needs the actual stone type confirmed. Outdoor porcelain, natural stone pavers and fired-clay products have different product instructions. Check that the material and finish suit the actual weather exposure, wet walking surface and cleaning routine.
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 我们评估实际户外材质与规格。仿石描述外观；Terracotta 可能指烧制陶土，也可能只是产品颜色；Bluestone 则是石材商品名称，需确认实际石种。户外瓷质砖、天然石材铺装板和烧制陶土产品的说明不同。应核对材质和表面是否适合实际风雨暴露、湿态行走与日常清洁。

courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.source: The tile thickness and intended installation method need to fit the base, falls, doorway levels and step edges. A porcelain paver is not automatically a direct substitute for a bonded tile. Send the supplier specification with the area you want finished so we can assess preparation, edge details and care before confirming the work.
courtyard-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/b.target: 产品厚度与拟定安装方式需适配基层、排水坡度、门口高度和台阶边缘。瓷质铺装板不能自动作为粘贴式瓷砖的直接替代品。请将供应商规格与拟施工区域一并提供，方便我们在确认工作前评估基层处理、边缘节点与养护要求。
